summary: MINISO Group disclosed via Form 6-K that Chairman & CEO Guofu Ye proposes to increase his shareholding by purchasing ADSs or ordinary shares on the open market or in private transactions. The aggregate purchase amount is not less than HK$50 million (~US$6.4 million) over 12 months. Ye currently beneficially owns ~63.7% of issued shares. Purchases will commence after the Q1 2026 blackout period. This insider buying signal underscores management's confidence; watch for actual execution pace and any open-market volume impact.
